director.title: A Message from the School Director
director.defaultMessage: Welcome to a community where every child is seen, heard, and valued. Our dedicated team of international educators is committed to providing an exceptional start to your child's lifelong learning journey. We believe that true excellence is achieved when rigor meets warmth.

hero.description: Nurturing curiosity, building character, and empowering the next generation of global citizens.

personas.title: Designed for Every Journey
personas.prospectiveDesc: Begin your journey with us. Explore our ethos and seamless admissions process.
personas.parentsDesc: Access real-time updates, campus news, and resources to support your child.
personas.studentsDesc: A safe, inspiring space where young minds flourish through play and discovery daily.

philosophy.title: An Environment for Growth
philosophy.description: We believe early childhood is the most critical phase of human development. Our approach ensures every child reaches their maximum potential.
philosophy.card1Desc: Our modern play-based curriculum encourages children to explore their world organically, fostering deep critical thinking skills.
philosophy.card2Desc: 24/7 security, medical staff on-site, and rigorous child protection policies.
philosophy.card3Desc: Fully accredited curriculum preparing students for top-tier primary schools worldwide.

programs.title: Academic Programs
programs.description: Tailored educational stages designed to meet the precise developmental needs of your child.

toddlers.title: Toddlers
toddlers.desc: Focusing on sensory exploration, motor skills, and early language development in a highly nurturing space.

prek.title: Pre-K
prek.desc: Introducing structured routines, collaborative play, and foundational concepts in math and literacy.

kindergarten.title: Kindergarten
kindergarten.desc: Full academic preparation ensuring a confident and seamless transition to primary school environments.

news.title: Campus News & Events
news.emptyText: Check back soon for the latest campus news!

gallery.title: A Glimpse of Campus Life
gallery.description: Modern facilities perfectly designed to stimulate young minds safely.
gallery.emptyText: Upload photos to the Gallery CMS to see them here.

cta.description: Admissions are currently open for the upcoming academic year. Secure your child's place in our community today.

about.heroDescription: At Pakdeepan Kindergarten School, we believe in cultivating a foundation of curiosity, empathy, and academic rigor in a warm, international setting.
about.messageTitle: A Message from the School Director

programs.title: Academic Programs
programs.description: Nurturing curiosity and laying the foundation for a lifelong love of learning through our specialized early childhood curriculum.
programs.subtitle: Programs by Age

contact.title: Connect With Us
contact.description: We welcome your inquiries and look forward to discussing how Pakdeepan Kindergarten School can be part of your family's educational journey.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Pakdeepan Kindergarten School, we are committed to protecting the privacy and security of our students, parents, staff, and broader community. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, and safeguard personal information in a manner that aligns with our core values of transparency and trust.
